Kdy měnit brzdové destičky a brzdovou ka: When to replace brake pads and brake fluid
Pískání, vibrace a delší brzdná dráha js: Squealing, vibration and longer stopping distances are signs not worth putting off.
Destičky vydrží podle stylu jízdy zhruba: Depending on how you drive, pads last tens of thousands of miles – less in town than on the motorway. A metallic squeal when braking is usually the wear indicator telling you the lining is running out. Vibration in the steering wheel or pedal often means warped discs.
Brzdová kapalina pohlcuje vlhkost ze vzd: Brake fluid absorbs moisture from the air. With water its boiling point drops, and on a long downhill the brakes can go “soft”. That’s why manufacturers usually prescribe a change every two years, regardless of mileage.
Při kontrole změříme tloušťku destiček i: During a check we measure pad and disc thickness and test the fluid. We only replace what is worn.
Jak se připravit na STK, aby auto prošlo: How to prepare for your vehicle inspection and pass first time
Nejčastější závady se dají najít a oprav: The most common faults can be found and fixed before you go.
Nové osobní auto jede na první technicko: How often your car needs an inspection depends on where you live and how old the car is. You’ll find the due date on your last inspection report. Take your vehicle registration document with you.
Auta nejčastěji neprojdou kvůli světlům: Cars most often fail on lights (bulbs out or headlights badly aimed), brakes (uneven performance), play in the steering and suspension, fluid leaks and emissions. Check your tyres too: tread depth must be at least 1.6 mm.
Při přípravě na STK projdeme to, na co s: When preparing for the inspection we check what the inspector looks at and fix anything that wouldn’t pass.
Rozvodový řemen: proč nečekat, až praskn: Timing belt: why not to wait until it snaps
Výměna podle předpisu stojí zlomek toho,: Replacing it on schedule costs a fraction of an engine repair after it breaks.
Rozvodový řemen synchronizuje pohyb píst: The timing belt keeps the pistons and valves in sync. In most modern engines, if it snaps the valves hit the pistons, and repairing the cylinder head costs many times more than replacing the belt.
Interval stanovuje výrobce v kilometrech: The manufacturer sets the interval in both miles and years – whichever comes first. A belt ages even on cars that do few miles. We replace the whole kit: belt, tensioner and idler pulleys, and usually the water pump when the belt drives it.
Motory s rozvodovým řetězem pevný interv: Engines with a timing chain often have no fixed interval, but the chain stretches over time. A warning sign is rattling just after a cold start.
